configurePresets.name: da14535
configurePresets.description: Builds a SysRAM image for the DA14535. The Renesas SDK and the LLVM toolchain are both found under external/; point at installs elsewhere with -DDA145XX_SDK_PATH= and -DLLVM_ARM_TOOLCHAIN_PATH=, or put them in a CMakeUserPresets.json.
